Running the deferred Task 16 real-tokenizer test with AIRACE_DATA at a tiny fixture build's 4096 tokenizer failed with [('knowledge-0168', 'Bandar Seri Begawan', 9, 8), ...]; 'Santo Domingo' took 4-7 of 8; every other exact answer fits. line: 116 (ExactItem.max_new_tokens = 8); used by ml/src/airace_ml/skills/facts.py:164 (item knowledge-0168); answer from skills/kb_data/countries.json:88; guard test tests/test_bench.py:737-739
scenario: knowledge-0168 ('The capital city of Brunei is called ___.') accepts only 'Bandar Seri Begawan'. Probe tokenizers split ' Bandar Seri Begawan' into 9-10 tokens; 'Begawan' occurs only about 14 times per MB of fact prose, so the real tok-v1 is unlikely to merge it much. If tok-v1 needs 9+ tokens, generation stops before the answer is complete, the extracted line never matches, and no model can ever pass the item (a permanent deflation of a frozen bench). On the owner's PC test_every_answer_fits_its_reply_budget_with_the_real_tokenizer starts running once data/tokenizer exists and would fail right after Task 15, which the non-technical owner cannot act on, forcing a bench-v1 change after it has been measured.
title: Knowledge exact items keep the default 8-token reply budget, but bench-v1 asks for 'Bandar Seri Begawan', which a 4096-entry BPE likely splits into 9-10 tokens

scenario: Spec §4.7 keys leaderboards on (bench version, category) and the rulings treat bench-v1 as frozen, but the suite is rebuilt in every process from generators, kb_data JSON, MiniPy (code.py:477-480 accepts programs by running them), checkers (instructions.py:267) and numpy Generator choice/permutation/integers. A KB fact fix, a word added to a generator table, a checker or MiniPy tweak, the function-prompt fix, or a numpy bump that changes Generator streams (NEP 19 gives no stream-compatibility promise) would produce different items still labelled 'bench-v1', and scores from before and after would be silently incomparable. title: Nothing pins the bench-v1 item set: it is regenerated from code, KB data and numpy streams at runtime, so it can drift silently under the same version label

evidence: Dumped live bench-v1 items via suite._bench_items(); read kb.py accepted_answers and scoring.py:56-70. The plural forms are not objects of any relation, so adding them changes no distractor or false-fact draw.
fix: Set animal_class also_accepted to the plural of each class (mammal->mammals, bird->birds, fish->fishes, reptile->reptiles, amphibian->amphibians, insect->insects, arachnid->arachnids). Only the exact items' answer lists change; the item stream stays the same.
scenario: knowledge-0151 (sloth), 0152 (owl), 0181 (emu) and 0198 (polar bear) ask 'What is the animal group of ...?' / 'Which group of animals ...?', which invite a plural, but accept only 'mammal'/'bird'. exact_match normalizes only quotes, trailing punctuation and case, so 'mammals' is wrong: 4 of the 50 free-answer knowledge items, up to 8% of the free-answer score for a model that knows the facts. The same accepted list feeds the personality factual probes.
title: Free-answer animal-class items reject the plural answers people usually give ('mammals', 'birds')

scenario: The seed-0 FalseFactPlan plants 'The peacock/rooster/stork is a kind of reptile.' as false-fact noise and G7 (gate.py:573-615) scores the model wrong when it prefers ' reptile'. In modern biology birds are a group within the reptiles, so these 'falsehoods' are true under another reading, breaking the KB's falsifiable contract (kb.py docstring). Reptile also appears as a wrong option in knowledge-0075 (swan) and consistency-011 (swallow); the keyed 'bird' is still best, so the MC harm is small.
title: Birds get 'reptile' as a distractor and as a planted false fact, though under the modern grouping birds are reptiles

title: 'A newborn hen' is a self-contradictory bench subject (a hen is an adult female chicken)
